definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of optometry is defined as: 1. The employment of any optometric means, including topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17, to determine the visual efficiency of the human visual system, including refractive and functional abilities, or to diagnose the presence of ocular disease or ocular manifestations of systemic disease and other departures from normal. 2. The diagnosis and treatment of the refractive and functional ability of the visual system and enhancement of visual performance... 3. Examining into the fact, condition or cause of ocular health or disease, or treating or rendering advice regarding a condition or cause of ocular health or disease... 4. Applying principles or techniques of optometric sciences in the diagnosis, prevention or treatment of a condition or cause of ocular health or disease.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of optometry is defined as:

value: Prescribing, furnishing, fitting or employing ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, frames, aids or prosthetic materials
Administering visual training, orthoptics, visual therapy or any other optometric means
Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes
Dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent under s. 449.18(6)(am)2.b.
Removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18
Use of topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17
methods_authorized.quote: Prescribing, furnishing, fitting or employing ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, frames, aids or prosthetic materials. Administering visual training, orthoptics, visual therapy or any other optometric means. Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes, dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent under s. 449.18 (6) (am) 2. b., or removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (with board certification or license issued on or after August 1, 2006) and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (with board certification or license issued on or after August 1, 2006). Specific agents are specified by rule promulgated by the secretary after consultation with the examining board, medical examining board, and pharmacy examining board. Optometrists may not dispense therapeutic agents except by prescribing or administering, or providing complimentary samples, or dispensing a therapeutic-delivering contact lens.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes, dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent under s. 449.18 (6) (am) 2. b., or removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Except as provided in par. (a), the practice of the profession of optometry does not include surgery or medical treatment.

surgery_definition.value: Surgery is not defined in the statute, but the practice of optometry expressly excludes 'surgery or medical treatment' except as provided within the defined scope of optometry.
